rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / FY2017 COLLECTION OF TAXES / RECEIVABLES SUMMARY / JUNE 30, 2017`, PDF page 43 of the FY2017 annual town report, marked `1 of 3` at its foot; pages 44 and 45 are the other two and are already proven. THE PAGE IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 1 word and the page holds one image at 243 dpi -- AND IT IS LANDSCAPE, so it was rotated into its own one-page PDF before any crop was aimed, and then read. THE PRINTED HEADER, verbatim, column by column: `FISCAL YEAR | FORWARD | COMMITTMENTS | ADJUSTMENTS | REFUNDS | PAYMENTS | ABATEMENTS | TRANSFER | BALANCES`. COMMITTMENTS is the publisher's spelling, with two Ts, and is recorded as printed. Two section headings, REAL ESTATE (11 levy years, 2007-2017) and PERSONAL PROPERTY (20 levy years, 1998-2017); 31 rows in all. WHY THE EXTRACTOR REFUSED THIS PAGE, AND WHY THE REFUSAL WAS ABOUT THE INSTRUMENT RATHER THAN THE DOCUMENT. `receivables-refused.csv` records `no single sign convention proves the page (6 of 8 rows at best); refused`. The page carries its sign IN EACH CELL -- a negative is printed in parentheses and in RED -- so the identity is a straight SUM of the seven columns, and an extractor looking for one subtraction pattern across the whole page cannot find one. Read as the page prints it, FORWARD + COMMITTMENTS + ADJUSTMENTS + REFUNDS + PAYMENTS + ABATEMENTS + TRANSFER = BALANCES CLOSES ON ALL 31 ROWS TO THE CENT. There is no grand total anywhere on the page, so 31 independent row assertions are the whole of the check, and they are a stronger one than a single total would be: a wrong digit in any cell breaks the row it is in. A BLANK CELL IS RECORDED AS 0.00 AND THAT IS A READING OF OURS, not something the page prints -- the page leaves the cell empty. It is recorded that way because the row identity needs every term; no claim is made that the town printed a zero. The one row where the distinction could matter, PERSONAL PROPERTY LEVY OF 2011, prints $7,806.41 under REFUNDS and ($7,806.41) under ABATEMENTS and nets to its unchanged FORWARD balance. AND THE COLUMN PLACEMENT IS SETTLED BY THE ARITHMETIC, NEVER BY EYE: every one of the 31 rows closes with the figures placed as transcribed, and a figure put under the wrong heading would break its row.
